schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    PRODUCT_NAME VARCHAR(255),
    UNIT_PRICE INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (UNIT_PRICE > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE SALES (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    SELLER_ID INT,
    BUYER_ID INT,
    SALE_DATE DATE,
    QUANTITY INT,
    PRICE INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (PRODUCT_ID) REFERENCES PRODUCT(PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (QUANTITY > 0),
    CHECK (PRICE > 0)
);
q1: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID,P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN SALES S WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID HAVING SUM(S.SALE_DATE>='2019-01-01' AND S.SALE_DATE<='2019-03-31') > 0 AND SUM(S.SALE_DATE>'2019-03-31' OR S.SALE_DATE<'2019-01-01')=0
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID,P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN SALES S WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID HAVING SUM(S.SALE_DATE>='2019-01-01' AND S.SALE_DATE<='2019-03-31') > 0 AND SUM(S.SALE_DATE>'2019-03-31' OR S.SALE_DATE<'2019-01-01')=0
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent. Q1 filters products whose all sales occur between '2019-01-01' and '2019-03-31' by using MIN(SALE_DATE) >= and MAX(SALE_DATE) <=. Q2 uses SUM conditions to count rows within and outside the date range, ensuring at least one row is inside and none are outside. These differ in how they handle multiple sales per product across the date range.
counterexample_dsp: A product with one sale inside the range will pass Q2 but not Q1 if another sale exists outside the range. Q1 requires all sales to be within the range, while Q2 only requires at least one sale inside and none outside.
